_comment: The single file-to-writer registry for ai-triad-data corpus files (TL t/4353#9, SO e/343#18). Each corpus file's canonical format is the one its owning writer produces; the t/4353 drift check (ai-triad-data CI, warn-only) compares each file against its own writer, and scripts/json-canonical.mjs (t/4356) reads the same map, so the per-file rule can't fork. Measured by the CL (round-trips at ai-triad-data 7dc19c88; research/comp-linguist/analyses/t4278-duplicate-nodes/). Writer refs are <lang>:<repo path> <entry point>; lib/data-formats/fileWriters.test.ts checks every referenced path exists. Change it by PR (T1: consumers branch on it).

The fix is in t/4356: a non-date-parsing read (PS 7.5+ -DateKind String, raw pass-through to Node, or System.Text.Json).
